title: Implement aisle auto-detect helper
description: Add a pure shopping-list helper that tokenizes free-form item text, strips supported quantity prefixes, and asks AisleConfig for exact canonical-name or alias matches before falling back to the last word.
acceptance_criteria: A new helper returns an aisle name string or nil without depending on SwiftUI view state.
The helper trims whitespace, attempts quantity-prefix stripping, checks the stripped text first, then checks the last word fallback.
No-match and empty-input paths return nil without mutating any external state.
